facts.value: Unconditionally changes the fighter to ftCo_MS_FallAerial with Ft_MF_None, animation start 0.0F, speed 1.0F, blend 0.0F, and a null final Fighter_GObj pointer argument. It then initializes fallaerial.smid to ftCo_SM_FallAerial and fallaerial.x4 to 0.0F.
facts.rationale: The final parameter is Fighter_GObj*, not a callback; identify the three animation arguments precisely.

facts.value: Provides the physics callback for the common FallAerial motion state. Entry and this wrapper do not require negative vertical velocity; the delegated routine chooses fast-fall behavior or the ordinary gravity/terminal-velocity update.
facts.rationale: Remove the implied downward-velocity invariant. The entry has no vertical-velocity test and the shared physics routine handles ongoing vertical motion.
